name: reward-bench-2-converted
description: A dataset and evaluation collection for training and evaluating reward models / preference models. It provides paired responses or reward labels used to measure how well learned reward functions align with human preferences and to benchmark ranking/selection performance. The benchmark is intended for assessing reward-prediction accuracy and preference-ranking quality in alignment and RLHF workflows.
reputation: A niche dataset used by researchers working on reward modeling and RLHF; limited broad adoption compared to larger public benchmarks.
